title: v1_112 / Notable fixes
content:
## Notable fixes

* [xtermjs/xterm.js #5737](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js/pull/5737): Fix ^C not working to end for newer fish + kitty keyboard protocol
* [microsoft/vscode-python #25849](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-python/pull/25849): Prevent double/triple activation from two extensions
